bibl.title: The Sack of Troy in Stesichorus and Apollodorus.
bibl.seg: Patrick J. Finglass, The Sack of Troy in Stesichorus and Apollodorus.
bibl.note: The papyrus fragments of Stesichorus' Sack of Troy help assess whether or not this poem had a profound influence on Apollodorus' account of the sack in the Epitome of his Bibliotheca: as this does not seem to be the case, Apollodorus' narrative should not be used to reconstruct Stesichorus' poem.
